200.body: The European Commission said on Saturday it was closely monitoring the crisis surrounding Poland’s Constitutional Tribunal, following a confrontation outside the court building on Friday night that was broadcast live on television. The opposition accuses Tusk’s government of attempting a coup.European conservatives accuse EU of silenceThe co-chairs of the European Conservatives and Reformists (ECR) group on Saturday condemned the Polish government’s actions, describing them as a violation of the rule of law, and backed President Nawrocki.“The Tusk government’s actions constitute a clear and grave violation of the rule of law. No government stands above the law,” ECR co-chair Nicola Procaccini said.He added that European institutions “must not avert their eyes” and said respect for national sovereignty and judicial independence must remain a matter of principle, “unaffected by political alliances”.The Tribunal’s legitimacy has been contested for more than a decade.

600.body: A Caerphilly borough man will be competing in a karate tournament in Poland next weekend. On November 7, he will be competing in Poland for the European Professional Karate Champion title in the Kumite Male Middleweight category against Mistrz Polski under the UKF banner. Callum Lewis has won a range of titles in the UK and Europe (Image: Callum Lewis) Among his titles last year were the 2025 PKL Clash of Titans Team Champions, and first place in the 75kg and above at the Poland European Championships. He has already got 2026 off to a good start, winning gold in the senior men's kata at the 2026 Polish Warriors competition and gold in the men's senior sanbon 76kg and above, and the shobu sanbon team kumite in Malta, as well as gold in the men's senior 75kg Sanbon at the GB Open Championships.
